title: 第3章 待我不薄第4章 没空
content_zh:
第3章待我不薄？被萧沉扼住咽喉，周凌韬发自内心地感到恐惧。
“你若杀我，家主和凌雪，不会放过你的！”
周凌韬大吼道。
“他们本来就想杀我。”
萧沉的瞳孔里闪过冰凉杀意，“拿他们来威胁我？可笑！”
咔嚓！
萧沉的五指轻轻用力，周凌韬的脖子瞬间被扭断，无力地倒向一旁。
他的尸体被萧沉如同死狗般随意扔到一旁，双眸到死都写着不甘。
不是应该由他来践踏昔日的远风城第一天才吗，为何，会死？
“谁敢在周府放肆！”
萧沉刚刚踏出房门，便有数道身影踏步而来，为首之人更是怒视萧沉。
“五长老，周狂云。”
萧沉同样凝视对方，这是与周狂昭平辈的人物，在众长老里颇为年轻，有希望冲击苦海境九重。
“是你杀了凌韬？”
周狂云对着萧沉喝问道。
“周狂昭那老狗怎么不在？”
萧沉冷声道。
“放肆！
家主名讳也是你这畜生可以直呼的吗？”
周狂云一步跨出，苦海境八重的威压轰然绽放！

顷刻间，一股狂霸威势降临在萧沉身上，如同一座大山般沉重恐怖，要将萧沉压垮来。
萧沉体内天功运转，道骨显威，对抗这股威压，脊背依旧挺得笔直。
周狂云眼中闪过一抹异色，萧沉不是成为废人了吗，怎么还能抗衡他的威压？
“这些年你兄妹二人皆在周府生活，我周家待你不薄，你竟然对凌雪图谋不轨，还杀我周家子弟。
看来，我周家真是瞎了眼，养了你这白眼狼。”
“对我不薄？”
萧沉冷笑了一声，杀了他父母，夺他道骨，将他妹妹嫁给魔头，这叫对他不薄？
“废话少说，把路让开！”
萧沉喝道。
“废物，你死期到了！”
周狂云抬手便是一掌，向着萧沉拍打而去，似有滔天怒气。
在远风城，比周狂云更强的没有几人，更别提修为尽失的萧沉了。
content_en:
Chapter 3 Treat me well? Being held by Xiao Chen's throat, Zhou Lingtao felt fear from the bottom of his heart.
"If you kill me, the head of the family and Ling Xue will not let you go!"
Zhou Lingtao yelled.
"They wanted to kill me."
Xiao Chen's pupils flashed with cold murderous intent, "Threatening them to me? Ridiculous!"
Click!
Xiao Chen's five fingers gently exerted force, and Zhou Lingtao's neck was instantly twisted and he fell to the side helplessly.
His body was thrown aside casually by Xiao Chen like a dead dog, his eyes filled with unwillingness until he died.
Shouldn't he be the one who trampled on the former number one genius of Yuanfeng City? Why would he die?
"Who dares to be so arrogant in the Zhou Mansion!"
As soon as Xiao Chen stepped out of the room, several figures stepped forward, and the leader glared at Xiao Chen angrily.
"Fifth Elder, Zhou Kuangyun."
Xiao Chen also stared at the other person. This was a person of the same generation as Zhou Kuangzhao. He was quite young among the elders and had the hope of reaching the ninth level of the Sea of Bitter Realm.
"Did you kill Ling Tao?"
Zhou Kuangyun asked Xiao Chenhe.
"Why isn't that old dog Zhou Kuangzhao here?"
Xiao Chen said coldly.
"Presumptuous!
Is it possible for a beast like you to call the head of the house by his name? "
Zhou Kuangyun stepped forward with one step, and the pressure of the eighth level of the Sea of Bitter Realm burst forth!
In an instant, a violent force descended on Xiao Chen, as heavy and terrifying as a mountain, threatening to crush Xiao Chen.
The heavenly power in Xiao Chen's body was circulating, and his Taoist bones showed his power. Against this coercion, his back remained straight.
A strange look flashed in Zhou Kuangyun's eyes. Hasn't Xiao Chen become a useless person? How can he still resist his pressure?
"Both your brother and sister have been living in the Zhou family these years. Our Zhou family has treated you well, but you actually plotted evil against Ling Xue and even killed the children of my Zhou family.
It seems that my Zhou family is really blind and raised a white-eyed wolf like you. "
"Aren't you kind to me?"
Xiao Chen sneered. He killed his parents, took away his moral bones, and married his sister to the devil. Is this being treated unfairly?
"Stop talking nonsense and get out of the way!"
Xiao Chen shouted.
"Trash, it's time for you to die!"
Zhou Kuangyun raised his hand and slapped Xiao Chen away, seemingly filled with overwhelming anger.
In Yuanfeng City, there were few people who were stronger than Zhou Kuangyun, let alone Xiao Chen, who had completely lost his cultivation.
